name: Protocolo de Demostración de Rentabilidad
objective: Test every covered game draw-by-draw as if the future were unknown, using only information available before each historical draw.
requiredPerDraw: verified prize table or verified payout evaluator
training history strictly before target draw
antiOverfitRules: Never tune a model using the result of the draw it is being tested on.
Freeze model parameters before evaluating a held-out period.
Report failed periods as well as successful periods.
Compare against a reproducible random baseline with the same number and cost of tickets.
Segment historical rule eras when game mechanics changed.
Use historical ticket prices and historical prize rules valid on the target date.
A method is not called profitable unless out-of-sample evidence remains positive after all costs and confidence bounds.

proofLevels.requirement: Historical retrospective only; no claim of edge.
Positive net ROI in chronological walk-forward simulation.
Positive excess ROI against reproducible random portfolios of identical cost.
Positive held-out performance across multiple subperiods with confidence interval lower bound above zero.
Positive sealed Shadow Ledger after deployment.

truth: Even the highest proof level is evidence of historical/prospective performance, not a mathematical guarantee of future profit.
